additional_flows_must_be_a_json_array_of: Additional flows must be a JSON array of objects
each_flow_needs_a_name_sender_numeric_ca: Each flow needs a name, sender, numeric CAN ID and receiver list. Use Add reverse flow to create a complete plan.
service_owned_execution_10_ms_scheduling: Service-owned execution · 10 ms scheduling quantum · peer RX verification
use_an_isolated_test_bus_normal_receiver: Use an isolated test bus. Normal receivers participate in ACK; listen-only receivers do not. Hardware compatibility remains unverified.
templates_replace_the_current_plan_setti: Templates replace the current plan settings. Review channels and validate before authorizing transmission.
all_candidates_and_criteria_are_frozen_b: All candidates and criteria are frozen before authorization. Exploration stops at the first unqualified candidate and selects the previous qualified rate. Fixed measurement never reduces its selected rate. Single scheduled stream; no RTT or additional flows.
shapes_use_a_10_ms_host_scheduler_quantu: Shapes use a 10 ms host scheduler quantum. Burst spacing must be at least one quantum; reserve includes the physical peak. Seeded deadlines are reproducible, not physical wire timing. Control frames count toward every rate and burst.
count_and_rate_include_both_checkpoint_a: Count and rate include both checkpoint and data frames; use even numbers. Full raw evidence is required. Missing checkpoints, retired data and ambiguous association cannot pass. No application CRC or authentication is claimed.
sample_every_n_matching_frames_0_off: Sample every N matching frames (0 = off)
these_values_remain_part_of_the_plan_whe: These values remain part of the plan when this section is closed.
ratios_use_integer_ppm_1000000_100_submi: Ratios use integer ppm: 1000000 = 100%. Submission ratio applies to every stage, including warmup. Unknown submissions, incomplete evidence and interrupted execution cannot pass.
maximum_out_of_range_per_receiver: Maximum out of range per receiver
maximum_dispatch_lateness_ms_blank_no_li: Maximum dispatch lateness (ms, blank = no limit)
window_slots_must_be_a_power_of_two_evic: Window slots must be a power of two. Evicted history is frozen; late arrivals cannot repair loss and prevent a pass. Transmit outcomes remain exact within the total memory limit.
sample_receive_queue_depth_and_residence: Sample receive queue depth and residence
observed_depth_is_a_sampled_lower_bound_: Observed depth is a sampled lower bound including other backlog. Residence measures backend receipt to host verification; native worker residence is in host timing.
record_sampled_host_timing_additional_ev: Record sampled host timing (additional evidence budget)
host_rx_minus_backend_call_completion_ma: Host RX minus backend call completion may be negative. Missing matches and unsupported worker queues stay explicit. These are host observations, without wire or cross-host latency claims.
declarations_are_saved_with_the_plan_the: Declarations are saved with the plan; they are not automatic electrical or hardware certification. Source file hashes are captured by the service without accepting library paths here.
the_form_defines_primary_add_up_to_seven: The form defines primary. Add up to seven explicit flows sharing this bus, bitrate, evidence quota and one device reservation. CAN IDs select arbitration priority on a real bus; virtual tests do not model wire arbitration.
each_flow_freezes_its_own_count_rate_id_: Each flow freezes its own count, rate, ID, tag, criteria and optional timing/RTT. Later edits to primary do not rewrite this JSON. Shared channels use one acquisition; stopping a flow does not stop a channel used by another flow.
normal_receiver_mode_participates_in_can: Normal receiver mode (participates in CAN ACK, no generated data frames)
i_authorize_transmission_on_the_selected: I authorize transmission on the selected test bus.
criteria_met_is_separate_from_complete_e: Criteria met is separate from complete evidence and completed execution.
software_and_selected_library_source_evi: Software and selected library source evidence
selected_dynamic_library_evidence_unavai: Selected dynamic library evidence: unavailable / not applicable
coverage_is_limited_to_sampled_sequences: Coverage is limited to sampled sequences and the retained matching window, separate from full online frame verification.
frozen_flow_plan_criteria_and_evidence: Frozen flow plan, criteria and evidence
group_totals_include_locally_generated_r: Group totals include locally generated RTT responses. A skipped request also leaves its planned response opportunity unused. Per-flow counters retain their request/responder semantics.
frozen_step_actual_load_and_decision_evi: Frozen step, actual load and decision evidence
conservative_aggregate_reserved_peak_not: conservative aggregate reserved peak, not a dynamic target
refresh_only_reconnects_the_display_paus: Refresh only reconnects the display. Pausing or closing this page does not stop an authorized test. Stored samples are not a complete capture.
